RC01.opening: 2D-animated, with rounded preschool characters, clean outlines and soft warm colors. A static medium shot begins in the composition of Picture 1: the short-haired boy in a yellow shirt and teal trousers sits at the left of a low toy-fishing table, with the mint-cardigan teacher beside him on the right. A shallow blue tray holds colorful magnetic toy fish; the boy holds a short toy rod above it.
beats: While the narration plays, the boy lowers the magnetic tip toward the orange toy fish, lets it attach, then steadily lifts the fish clear of the tray. The teacher follows the rising fish with her eyes; both keep their lips closed.
The teacher looks from the lifted fish to the boy and speaks with a gentle smile. The boy listens without speaking and holds the rod steady, keeping the orange fish suspended beside the teacher.
RC01.ending: The boy finishes raising the rod into the angle shown in Picture 2 and holds the orange fish above the tray. The teacher settles into the same seated position and smile as the final reference; the camera, table and tray remain fixed.

RC03.opening: 2D-animated in the warm pastel style of Picture 1. A static wide shot frames a clear classroom activity floor: the coral-shirt boy stands on the left, the yellow-shirt boy in the middle, and the purple-shirt girl with two braids on the right. The mint-cardigan teacher stands behind them near the small music player, with the shelves and windows kept in their reference positions.
beats: During the narration, the children make small alternating steps and gently swing their forearms, keeping comfortable space between them. Their lips remain closed; the dance and the visible music player produce no audible music or movement sounds.
The teacher smiles and speaks her encouragement while the children continue the small dance gestures without speaking. Their arms gradually rise toward the positions in the final reference.
RC03.ending: The children settle into the arm positions and foot placements of Picture 2 while the teacher remains behind them. The shot stays static, retaining the same spacing, floor and background.

RC04.opening: 2D-animated, with the same soft colors and rounded figures as Picture 1. A static wide shot frames the blue padded single-child trampoline: the yellow-shirt boy stands alone on its bed, the purple-shirt girl waits on the floor to the right, and the mint-cardigan teacher supervises from the left. Keep the reference handrail, mat and classroom layout unchanged.
beats: During the narration, the boy holds the handrail with both hands and makes two very low, controlled bounces. The girl waits outside the trampoline and the teacher watches; all visible mouths remain closed.
With both feet resting on the trampoline bed, the boy looks up and speaks happily while retaining his grip on the handrail. The girl and teacher listen silently.
RC04.ending: The boy's body stops bobbing and returns to the upright stance in Picture 2, which shares the opening composition. The girl stays on the floor and the teacher remains beside the trampoline; no one changes places.

RC05.opening: 2D-animated, with warm evening light and the same rounded characters as Picture 1. A static medium-wide two-shot frames the yellow-shirt boy approaching from the left and his mother, in a peach top and cream trousers, kneeling on the right. The cream sofa, low table, lamp and evening window remain in their reference positions.
beats: The mother faces the boy at his eye level and gently invites him to speak. As she talks, the boy completes his approach, plants both feet and brings his hands nearer his chest, looking at her without interrupting.

The boy begins his account with the brief hesitation and pauses already written in his dialogue, making a small pretend-fishing gesture with one hand. His mother stays still and listens with a closed mouth, without finishing the words for him.
RC05.ending: The boy settles on the left in the speaking posture of Picture 2, with his mother still kneeling to the right and watching attentively. His hand movement diminishes into the final reference gesture without changing the camera or room layout.

RC07.opening: 2D-animated in the soft, warm style of Picture 1. A static medium two-shot begins with the yellow-shirt boy standing on the left, one hand lifted near his chest, and his peach-shirt mother kneeling on the right beside the cream sofa. Keep their faces, clothing, spacing and evening lighting consistent with the reference.
beats: The boy speaks excitedly, retaining only the hesitations and pauses written in his dialogue. He lightly bends his knees to mime a bounce, then opens his hands into a small dancing gesture. His mother watches patiently with her lips closed.
As the narration begins, the boy closes his mouth and lets the small gesture settle. His mother makes a slight acknowledging nod, keeping her lips closed and her attention on him.
RC07.ending: The boy's hands and shoulders gradually settle into the pose in Picture 2. His mother returns from the small nod to the final listening posture, preserving the same two-shot and furniture positions.

RC09.opening: 2D-animated, warm evening light, a static medium two-shot matching Picture 1. The yellow-shirt boy stands on the left facing his peach-shirt mother, who kneels on the right beside the cream sofa; his hands are still slightly lifted from a small gesture.
beats: The mother responds with a broad, warm smile while slowly opening her arms. As she continues speaking, the boy lowers his hands and leans toward her; she gently draws him into a side hug. The boy remains silent.
RC09.ending: The mother finishes drawing the boy against her shoulder and settles both arms into the embrace shown in Picture 2. Their faces relax into the reference smiles, with the same kneeling height, sofa and static framing.

RC10.opening: 2D-animated in the soft evening palette of Picture 1. A static medium shot begins with the peach-shirt mother kneeling on the right and holding the yellow-shirt boy in the close side hug shown in the reference, beside the cream sofa.
beats: The mother gently loosens the hug so the boy can stand upright to her left. Facing him at eye level, she uses a small open-hand gesture while calmly speaking the entire example sentence herself, including the quoted portion. The boy looks at her with his mouth closed and does not repeat it.
RC10.ending: The mother settles into the open-handed teaching gesture of Picture 2 and the boy rests his arms in the final listening pose. Their embrace has fully released, while their positions, the room and the camera remain unchanged.

RC11.opening: 2D-animated, warm soft colors, a static medium two-shot anchored in Picture 1. The yellow-shirt boy stands at the left of the cream sofa, looking at his peach-shirt mother kneeling to the right; her hand is still open toward him after a small explanatory gesture.
beats: The boy slowly gives his complete account, retaining the brief pauses already present in the dialogue. He lifts one hand slightly toward his chest and gradually straightens with a small proud smile. His mother lowers her explanatory hand and listens with her mouth closed until he finishes.
The mother then gives her spoken encouragement and lightly brings her palms together twice in silent applause. The boy listens, smiling toward her, without adding any reply.
RC11.ending: The mother's second gentle clap settles into the palm position shown in Picture 2. The boy finishes in the reference stance with his hand near his chest and his face turned toward her; their eye contact and the static framing remain steady.

RC13.opening: 2D-animated, with the warm evening light and composition of Picture 1. A static medium two-shot frames the yellow-shirt boy standing on the left and his peach-shirt mother kneeling on the right, her palms held near one another after applause. The cream sofa and lamp remain behind them.
beats: During the narration, the mother relaxes her hands a little and gives a small nod toward the boy. He answers with a quiet smile and a slight lift of his chin, keeping one hand near his chest; both keep their mouths closed.
RC13.ending: The mother returns her hands to the relaxed position near one another shown in Picture 2, and both settle from the small nods into the original facing poses. The final reference repeats the opening framing, without another clap or a change of scene.

RE01.opening: 2D-animated, with the warm pastel group-portrait composition of Picture 1. The mint-cardigan teacher and peach-shirt mother stand behind them. Preserve the combined kindergarten-and-living-room background and the small decorative graphics already present in the reference, without adding text or new graphics.
beats: Throughout the narration, the five characters hold the group arrangement, blinking naturally and making only slight nods and small changes of expression. All visible mouths remain closed; no character steps forward or starts another action.
RE01.ending: The slight nods settle back into the smiles, head angles and spacing of Picture 2, which repeats the opening group portrait. The decorative background and camera remain completely stationary.

RE03.opening: 2D-animated in the warm pastel style of Picture 1. beats: As the narration plays, the yellow-shirt boy briefly turns his eyes and head toward his mother behind him. She responds with a small smile; he then turns gently back toward the camera. The other three characters hold their places, and all visible mouths remain closed.
RE03.ending: The boy completes the return of his gaze toward the camera, matching his head angle in Picture 2. The whole group settles into the same reference poses and spacing, without moving the camera or changing the background.

RE04.opening: 2D-animated, a static wide group portrait in the warm pastel composition of Picture 1. The coral-shirt boy stands at the front left, the purple-shirt girl in the front middle and the yellow-shirt boy at the front right; the mint-cardigan teacher and peach-shirt mother stand behind them. beats: During the narration, the yellow-shirt boy looks directly toward the camera and starts to lift his hand toward the farewell pose. All five characters keep their lips closed while the narrator speaks.
The yellow-shirt boy speaks his farewell toward the camera while making a small, gentle wave. The other children and the two adults remain smiling silently in their places.
RE04.ending: The boy finishes speaking, closes his mouth into a smile and lets the wave settle with his hand raised exactly as in Picture 2. The other four characters retain their final reference poses and spacing, and the shot ends without an added hold, cut or camera move.
